text:
A beam of α-particles and β-particles is incident at right angles to an electric field.
Which statement about the deflection of the particles in the field is correct?
α-particles deflect, but β-particles do not deflect.
A
α-particles deflect in the opposite direction to β-particles.
B
β-particles deflect, but α-particles do not deflect.
C
Both α-particles and β-particles deflect in the same direction.
D

options.label: A
options.text: α-particles deflect, but β-particles do not deflect.

options.label: B
options.text: α-particles deflect in the opposite direction to β-particles.

options.label: C
options.text: β-particles deflect, but α-particles do not deflect.

options.label: D
options.text: Both α-particles and β-particles deflect in the same direction.
